summary_zh: 空调通过制冷循环调节室内温度与湿度。1902年威利斯·开利发明现代电力温湿度调节系统，20世纪中叶小型化窗机与分体机走入千家万户，重塑了现代城市生活与建筑方式。
summary_en: The air conditioner controls indoor temperature and humidity. Willis Carrier designed the modern system in 1902, and mid-20th-century residential units reshaped modern buildings and comfort.
